mapper.sql:
WITH -- CTE1: 今日佣金（自身） today_commissions AS ( SELECT user_id, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = 'fy' THEN transaction_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_commission FROM goods_transaction_flow WHERE created_time >= CURDATE() AND created_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY user_id ), -- CTE2: 上级佣金（针对每个下级ou.id过滤；性能仍需表结构调整，假设remark包含下级ID） parent_commissions AS ( SELECT gtf.user_id AS parent_id, gtf_child.id AS child_id, IFNULL(SUM(gtf.transaction_amount), 0) AS today_parent_commission FROM goods_transaction_flow gtf JOIN order_user gtf_child ON gtf.remark LIKE CONCAT('%', gtf_child.id, '%') WHERE gtf.created_time >= CURDATE() AND gtf.created_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND gtf.transaction_type = 'fy' GROUP BY gtf.user_id, gtf_child.id ), -- CTE3: 最后登录（窗口函数替换子查询） last_logins AS ( SELECT user_id, ip, address, create_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY create_time DESC) AS rn FROM order_login_log ), -- CTE4: 提现统计 withdrawal_stats AS ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN create_time >= CURDATE() AND create_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 END) AS today_withdrawal_count, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_withdrawal_amount FROM order_withdrawal GROUP BY user_id ), -- CTE5: 充值统计 recharge_stats AS ( SELECT user_id, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_recharge_amount FROM goods_recharge_record GROUP BY user_id ), -- CTE6: 直属下级数 children_stats AS ( SELECT parent_id AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS direct_children_count FROM order_user GROUP BY parent_id ) -- 主查询 SELECT ou.id, ou.username, ou.phone_number, ou.avatar, ou.vip_id, ou.parent_id, ou.balance, ou.frozen_balance, ou.base_salary, ou.task_progress, ou.reputation_score, ou.invite_code, ou.gender, ou.email, ou.birthday, ou.is_enabled, ou.allow_invite, ou.is_frozen, ou.is_fake, ou.is_banned, ou.work_limit, ou.is_withdrawal_notification, ou.product_matching, ou.account_status, ou.transaction_status, ou.withdrawal_status, ou.deposit_block_withdrawal, ou.remarks, ou.version, ou.create_time, ou.update_time, ou.password, ou.trade_password, ou.assist_withdrawal_status, ou.ancestors, ou.today_rest, ou.total_rest,
gml.id AS member_level_id, gml.name, gml.level, gml.icon, gml.price, gml.min_balance, gml.invite_count, gml.order_count_per_day, gml.min_commission_rate, gml.max_commission_rate, gml.min_continuous_commission_rate, gml.max_continuous_commission_rate, gml.task_count_per_day, gml.withdraw_count_per_day, gml.withdraw_fee_rate, gml.min_withdraw_amount, gml.withdraw_limit_per_day, gml.min_withdraw, gml.max_withdraw, gml.description, gml.product_match_enabled, gml.product_match_min, gml.product_match_max,
pu.username AS parent_username, pu.invite_code AS parent_invite_code,
-- 额外字段：从CTE JOIN COALESCE(tc.today_commission, 0) AS today_commission, COALESCE(pc.today_parent_commission, 0) AS today_parent_commission, ll.ip AS last_login_ip, ll.address AS last_login_address, ll.create_time AS last_login_time, COALESCE(cs.direct_children_count, 0) AS direct_children_count, COALESCE(ws.today_withdrawal_count, 0) AS today_withdrawal_count, COALESCE(ws.total_withdrawal_amount, 0) AS total_withdrawal_amount, COALESCE(rs.total_recharge_amount, 0) AS total_recharge_amount
FROM order_user ou LEFT JOIN goods_member_level gml ON ou.vip_id = gml.id LEFT JOIN order_user pu ON ou.parent_id = pu.id LEFT JOIN today_commissions tc ON ou.id = tc.user_id LEFT JOIN parent_commissions pc ON ou.parent_id = pc.parent_id AND ou.id = pc.child_id LEFT JOIN last_logins ll ON ou.id = ll.user_id AND ll.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN withdrawal_stats ws ON ou.id = ws.user_id LEFT JOIN recharge_stats rs ON ou.id = rs.user_id LEFT JOIN children_stats cs ON ou.id = cs.user_id

#{username}, #{phoneNumber}, #{avatar}, #{vipId}, #{parentId}, #{balance}, #{frozenBalance}, #{baseSalary}, #{taskProgress}, #{reputationScore}, #{inviteCode}, #{gender}, #{email}, #{birthday}, #{isEnabled}, #{allowInvite}, #{isFrozen}, #{isFake}, #{isBanned}, #{workLimit}, #{isWithdrawalNotification}, #{productMatching}, #{accountStatus}, #{transactionStatus}, #{withdrawalStatus}, #{depositBlockWithdrawal}, #{remarks}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{password}, #{tradePassword}, #{assistWithdrawalStatus}, #{ancestors},
mapper.update: UPDATE order_user SET parent_id = #{newParentId}, ancestors = CASE WHEN #{newParentId} = 0 OR #{newParentId} IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE (SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(sub.ancestors, '0'), ',', sub.id) FROM (SELECT ancestors, id FROM order_user WHERE id = #{newParentId}) sub LIMIT 1) END, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{userId} AND version = #{version}
